segment.description: Whiteoak Creek (TWRA schedule spelling 'Whiteoak Creek'; catalog name 'White Oak Creek'), Houston County with headwaters in Humphreys County (West Tennessee): a roughly 30-mile creek draining southwest to Kentucky Lake / the Tennessee River near Danville-McKinnon. TWRA stocks it at the 'White Oak Creek Spring Trout Site' (36.2590, -87.8716). Temperature evidence is from the upper-reach USGS station near Concord on the same creek.
segment.boundaries: Humphreys/Houston county reach from headwaters to the Kentucky Lake mouth (~36.26, -87.94); keyed to USGS 03605968 'Whiteoak Creek near Concord' (36.2395, -87.7850) on the upper creek and the TWRA stocking site mid-creek.

coldSource.notes: Station identity verified via https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/site/?sites=03606020,03606125,03605968&siteOutput=expanded&format=rdb (WHITEOAK CREEK NEAR CONCORD, Humphreys County, HUC 06040005) - same creek and HUC as the Houston County stocking site, on the upper reach.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found. Stocking is Seasonal only: schedule weeks of 2/22, 3/22, 3/29/2026, all Rainbow Trout (the prior verified pass additionally noted a completed 4/30/2026 event on TWRA's live stocking-report page).

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout population documented. The creek has no entry anywhere on TWRA's trout-regulations page (no wild-trout, special-regulation, or delayed-harvest listing; verified by string search of the live page) and no trout survey record was found. Other same-name Tennessee creeks (Macon, Scott, Morgan counties) have no trout program and are different waters.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: USGS summer grab samples 1984-1985 on the upper creek (03605968) hit 28 C in July (23 C in September, 21 C in June), and the only documented fishery is a 3-week Feb-Mar seasonal rainbow stocking.
